An Outstanding Institution Shaping Young Minds

St. Francis Xavier's High School, Naigaon, stands out as a remarkable institution dedicated to holistic student development. Principal Madam Mrs. Sunita Fernandes looks after the smooth running of both schools - St. Francis Xavier's High School and Little Rose Nature School.

Sports enthusiasts will appreciate the state-of-the-art SFX Turf and SFX Sports Hall, built to international standards, offering facilities for cricket, football, badminton, and volleyball by Managing Director Mr. Priben Pereira. The school's recent victories in inter-school tournaments further demonstrate its commitment to excellence in sports by guidance of their experienced coaches .

What sets St. Francis Xavier's High School apart is its emphasis on inculcating moral values. Assemblies filled with action songs and words of wisdom, led by the inspiring Manager Sir Mr. Benedict Pereira, nurture students’ minds and align their thoughts with positivity and purpose.

If you're seeking an institution where academic excellence meets character building, St. Francis Xavier's High School, Naigaon, is a shining example!

customer_updates.text:
Blood Donation Camp at Vasai Railway Station – Review (College Memories 📝)

Event Overview

The Blood Donation Camp was successfully organized at Vasai Railway Station in collaboration with NSS Unit SSSM College Naigaon, Rotary Club of Vasai & Virar, Sunrise Oncology Centre, and Maheshwari Seva Sanstha, Vasai. The camp took place on April 4, 2024, from morning till late afternoon, providing a well-managed and hygienic setup for blood donors.

Organization & Setup

The venue was strategically chosen near Vasai Railway Station, ensuring easy accessibility.

The setup included multiple beds for donors, medical equipment, and cooling arrangements (fans and coolers) for comfort.

Volunteers actively guided donors and ensured smooth operations.

Clear banners and informative posters emphasized the importance of blood donation.

Participation & Impact

As students of SSSM College and volunteers, we had an enriching experience organizing and managing the camp.

We learned valuable skills such as event coordination, teamwork, and public engagement.

Our college principal and professors, especially Vandana Ma’am, played a crucial role in encouraging us to participate and contribute to this noble cause. Their motivation inspired many students to step forward and donate.

A good number of students, faculty, and general public participated in donating blood.

Medical professionals ensured a safe and hygienic donation process.

Donors were provided refreshments and a token of appreciation.

The event promoted awareness about the lifesaving impact of blood donation, reinforcing community service values among students.

Highlights

✔ Hands-on learning experience for student volunteers.
✔ Strong encouragement from our college principal and professors, boosting student participation.
✔ Well-organized medical setup ensuring donor safety.
✔ Strong collaboration between college, medical institutions, and service organizations.
✔ Enthusiastic participation from students and community members.
✔ Positive social impact by contributing to local blood banks.

Areas for Improvement

Increased public outreach to encourage more participation.

More awareness campaigns before the event to boost engagement.

Consider extending donation hours to accommodate more donors.

Final Verdict

The blood donation camp was a well-organized, impactful, and socially responsible initiative. As students and volunteers from SSSM College, we not only contributed to a noble cause but also gained valuable learning experiences in teamwork, event management, and community service. With the support of our principal and professors, especially Vandana Ma’am, we felt motivated and empowered to participate in this meaningful initiative.

featured_reviews.review_text:
If you just passed your 10th standard with good marks please do not destroy your future by joining SSSM (Sahyadri shikshan seva mandal) College. I made the mistake of choosing it because it is close to my home and has low fees but it is not worth it. Even if you are a topper you will lose your focus here. The environment is very bad and toxic.
​The teaching quality is terrible. Teachers just come to the class read the textbook and leave. If you ask them any doubt they will just ignore it and start another topic. There are no proper practicals no guidance and no focus on student growth. Students come in that college who has just 35 to 40% in 10th boards and have no interest in studies. I had gone to this college, I regret a lot it was my life biggest mistake ever and you don't repeat it. If you want to protect your career please spend some money or travel a long distance to go to a better college. Traveling will become a habit but joining this college will ruin your percentage and your future plans. Stay away from SSSM.
